description: Session 44 and older per-feature edit maps keyed by rendered SVG ID (input.features, with the Session's diagram mode and its saved feature catalog, or without one `legacy`: the request records and the source features read again or the saved feature metadata, projected to the fields the readers use) and the Session 45 features both readers must produce: features.featureOverrides rows keyed by [mode, recordKey, biologicalFeatureId], the four maps removed, labelOverrideRows cleared when a label map was migrated, and the counts of dropped and narrowed edits. A case with `fixture` is projected from that Session saved by first-parent main; a Session 31-39 case's `sourceReads` are the reads Web Load makes of its sources (resource, region spec, record selector, reverse flag), and its `legacy` features are what those reads give. Read by tests/test_session_compat.py (session_io.migrate_session_feature_edits, session_migration.legacy_source_reads and read_legacy_source_features) and tests/web/feature-edit-migration.test.mjs (migrateSessionFeatureEdits). `sourceReadCases` replace the Linear request records of `fixture` with `records`; `sourceReads` are the GenBank reads Web Load makes of them (request projection, buildLinearRegionExtractionContext) and the Python twin (session_migration.legacy_source_reads) must give: a crop as `<start>-<end>[:rc]` without the reverse flag, otherwise the record's reverse flag, and its record selector (recordId value or `#<index + 1>`).
